SUMMARY: TableDiningFactory procedurally builds a single dining-table assembly: one tabletop (n-gon cylinder with fillets) plus a set of legs (straight/single_stand/square) and optional strechers, joined into one mesh with sampled materials. The upper-level files define the geometry nodegroups (tabletop, leg styles, strecher, shared table utilities) and the factory that samples all dimensions/styles and wires them together. SideTableFactory and CoffeeTableFactory subclass it with different default dimensions.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/tables/dining_table.py
  TableDiningFactory.sample_parameters: samples all table geometry params (fixed default entry point).
    knobs: width(uniform 0.91-1.16) -> table width; length oblong(uniform 1.4-2.8, prob 0.7)/square(width*normal(1,0.1)) -> table length; height(uniform 0.65-0.85) -> table height; leg_style(choice straight 0.5/single_stand 0.1/square 0.4) -> leg design; NGon(4 fixed) -> tabletop cross-section sides; Top Profile Fillet Ratio(uniform 0.0-0.02) -> tabletop corner rounding; Top Thickness(uniform 0.03-0.06) -> tabletop slab thickness; Top Vertical Fillet Ratio(uniform 0.1-0.3) -> tabletop vertical edge rounding; Strecher Relative Pos(uniform 0.2-0.6) -> strecher height along legs; Strecher Increament(choice 0/1/2) -> strecher count/connection between legs
    knobs (single_stand): leg_number(2 fixed); leg_diameter(uniform 0.22x-0.28x); leg_curve_ctrl_pts(random pts, tapers) -> stand silhouette; top_scale(uniform 0.6-0.7); bottom_scale(1.0)
    knobs (square): leg_number(2 fixed); leg_diameter(uniform 0.07-0.10); top_scale(0.8); bottom_scale(1.0)
    knobs (straight): leg_number(4 fixed); leg_diameter(uniform 0.05-0.07); leg_curve_ctrl_pts(random taper to 0.4-0.6); top_scale(0.8); bottom_scale(uniform 1.0-1.2)
  TableDiningFactory.get_material_params: assigns materials & wear.
    knobs: TopMaterial(weighted_sample material_assignments.table_top) -> tabletop look; LegMaterial(weighted_sample material_assignments.tableware) -> leg look; scratch/edge_wear(prob from material_assignments.wear_tear_prob; currently NOT applied in finalize_assets—uncomment to enable)
    knobs: clothes_scatter(NoApply; commented ClothesCover, uniform<.3) -> optional blanket cover
  geometry_create_legs: dispatches leg nodegroup by Leg Style; sets Leg Resolution(single_stand 64, straight 32), straight Fillet Ratio(0.1 fixed), square width factor(0.707), strecher profile width(Leg Diameter*0.5).
  geometry_assemble_table: builds tabletop, translates to Top Height, sets materials, joins tabletop+legs into one object.
  SideTableFactory.__init__: default dims w=0.55*normal(1,0.05), h=0.95*w*normal(1,0.05) -> small square side table.
  CoffeeTableFactory.__init__: default dims (uniform 1-1.5, uniform 0.6-0.9, uniform 0.4-0.5) -> low wide coffee table.

FILE: assets/objects/tables/table_top.py
  nodegroup_generate_table_top: core tabletop mesh from n-gon profile with horizontal fillet + vertical edge fillet; tags top face as SupportSurface. knobs: Profile Resolution(512), Resolution(10), FilletCurve Count(8).
  nodegroup_capped_cylinder: alternative rounded-cap cylinder top (unused by dining factory). knobs: Cap Flatness, Cap Relative Scale/Z Offset, uv-sphere Rings(Radius*257).
  TableTopFactory.sample_parameters: standalone tabletop asset defaults (Profile N-gon 4, Width 1.0, Aspect 1.0, Fillet 0.2, Thickness 0.1, Vertical Fillet 0.2).

FILE: assets/objects/tables/legs/straight.py
  nodegroup_generate_leg_straight: tapered/straight cylindrical leg via radius curve + n-gon cylinder. knobs: N-gon(default 32, factory passes Leg NGon=4), Fillet Ratio(0.01 default), Leg Curve Control Points (from factory).

FILE: assets/objects/tables/legs/single_stand.py
  nodegroup_generate_single_stand: central pedestal leg, Resolution 64. knobs: Leg Curve Control Points (silhouette), Aspect Ratio(1.0 fixed), Fillet Ratio(0 fixed).

FILE: assets/objects/tables/legs/square.py
  nodegroup_generate_leg_square: bent U/frame leg from arc curve swept along n-gon profile. knobs: Fillet Radius(0.03 default), Has Bottom Connector(bool from Strecher Increament), FilletCurve Count(8), Profile N-gon(4)/Width/Aspect(0.5)/Fillet(0.1).

FILE: assets/objects/tables/strechers.py
  nodegroup_strecher: straight cylindrical crossbar between legs. knobs: N-gon(32 default), Profile Width (factory passes Leg Diameter*0.5).

FILE: assets/objects/tables/table_utils.py
  nodegroup_n_gon_profile: builds fillable n-gon cross-section curve (Radius 0.5 fixed, FilletCurve Count 8).
  nodegroup_n_gon_cylinder: sweeps profile along radius curve -> tapered cylinder mesh + caps; Resolution/Profile Resolution defaults.
  nodegroup_generate_radius_curve: converts control points to a taper curve for legs/top.
  nodegroup_create_anchors: places leg anchor points (handles N-gon=1 point, =2 line, else polygon corners); scale factor 0.3535.
  nodegroup_create_legs_and_strechers: instances legs on anchors + optional strechers with odd/even keep logic, Strecher Index Increment/Relative Position, Align Leg X rot.
  nodegroup_create_cap / arc_top / align_bottom_to_floor / bent / merge_curve: helper geometry ops (caps, arcs, floor alignment, bending, curve merge).

FILE: assets/objects/tables/__init__.py
  Exports TableCocktailFactory, CoffeeTableFactory, SideTableFactory, TableDiningFactory, TableTopFactory (registration only).

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/composition/material_assignments.py -> material palettes (table_top, tableware) + wear_tear probabilities for sampling
  assets/materials/metal|wood|plastic|ceramic|fabric/... -> shader material generators referenced by material assignments
  assets/materials/wear_tear/edge_wear.py, scratches.py -> surface wear effects (currently disabled in finalize)
  core/nodes/node_wrangler.py, node_utils.py, node_info.py -> geometry-node graph construction API (Nodes, NodeWrangler, to_nodegroup, assign_curve)
  core/surface.py -> add_geomod applies geometry-node modifier to base mesh
  core/tagging.py, tags.py -> face tagging (SupportSurface) and tag_system relabeling
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base class / create_asset lifecycle
  core/placement/detail.py -> level-of-detail utilities
  core/util/math.py -> FixedSeed deterministic sampling
  core/util/random.py -> weighted_sample material selection
  core/util/blender.py, object.py, color.py, logging.py -> Blender object helpers, color utils, logging
  core/nodes/compatibility.py, utils.py -> node version compatibility shims
